ops.body: - **A failed-save line doesn't survive a reload** (errors-handled audit 2): the failures and their retries are kept in memory, so after a reload the choice that wasn't saved falls back without a word. A store that just refused a write can't keep the line either; a later slice could keep it in memory-backed meta written when the store has room again.
ops.intro: Every caught error is handled by its kind and kept in a log on the device (decision 0179, specs/errors-handled). Left from its audit (Nov 16):

ops.body: - **The ready bar's grab handle draws over the text under it** (errors-handled audit 22, seen in the diagnostics journey's picture): the scrolling settings run under the 28 px handle band. The ready bar's, not this slice's; clip the scroll below the band.

- **A failed save of the map layers shows on the walk and ready screens, not on Explore** (errors-handled audit 7): the layers' shell is shared by every map and doesn't know which screen set it; it is tagged as a setting. Passing the screen through `layers.set` would place it.

the words changed in the audit (errors-handled audit 16, 17)
ops.body: - [ ] **Do:** with the phone nearly full, change Distances in the walk settings. **Expect:** one line beside the capture buttons, 16 px clear of them, "Your Distances choice wasn’t saved: there’s no room left. Free some room, then Retry."; Retry after freeing room clears it, a Retry that fails again says "still" (EH7, EH13, EH14, errors-handled audit 16, 17)

- [ ] **Do:** with the phone nearly full, walk, stand still for a minute, walk on, then free room and tap Retry. **Expect:** the still spell is saved closed, with its end, and later spells are kept as they happen (`putStill`, errors-handled audit 3); Hide on the walk's line sets it aside until something new fails, and it shows again after Stop (audit 15)

- [ ] **Do:** make the database unable to open (a full disk at launch), then use the app for a minute. **Expect:** no runaway: the app stays responsive and the battery steady; Share diagnostics still shares the session's entries (errors-handled audit 1)

- [ ] **Do:** tap Share diagnostics, then dismiss the share sheet without choosing an app. **Expect:** the note keeps saying what the text holds, never "Shared."; the header names the platform and its version, never the model (errors-handled audit 11, 13)
